title: M7 · How you build Home
question: Three ways to shape your own shelves, write smart rules and quick-open with ⌘K. All keep Bias Light; this picks the working model. Lock one, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: Say It
options.lineage: Spotlight and Raycast, with Mail's smart-mailbox rules underneath
options.thesis: ⌘K is where shelves are born: type what you want, it becomes rule chips, ⌘S pins it to Home.
materials: solid graphite palette under the toolbar
options.viewport: ⌘K drops a solid panel from under the toolbar, left-aligned on the 40 pt gutter: a field, then sections (Titles, People, Collections, Go to, Commands). Typing "unwatched comedy 90s" turns words into lilac-outlined chips (Unwatched · Genre Comedy · 1990s) with a live poster strip and count beneath; Return opens the results as a grid, ⌘S saves them as a Home shelf. Home itself gains Edit Home (⌘E): shelves fold to 72 pt strips with a grip, a hide switch and the rule summary; drag or ⌥↑/⌥↓ to reorder.
options.risk: Typed rules need a forgiving parser; anything it can't read must fall back to an explicit chip picker so the wife isn't stuck.

regions.label: Home (dimmed, room light follows top result)

options.label: Edit in Place
options.lineage: macOS Edit Toolbar and Control Centre customisation
options.thesis: Home rearranges itself: ⌘E folds every shelf to a strip you drag, hide or open; smart shelves get a rule sheet with a live preview.
options.viewport: Edit Home (⌘E, or the toolbar's Edit button) folds the hero away and shows shelves as 72 pt strips: grip, title, source (Plex hub, Collection, Smart), a poster peek, hide switch, ⋯. Add Shelf at the end opens a menu: Plex rows, a Collection…, a Playlist…, New Smart Shelf…. The smart shelf sheet is native rule rows (Genre · is · Comedy) with + / −, Sort, Limit, and a live poster row with the count at the bottom. ⌘K is a plain list palette for titles, people, places and commands.
options.risk: The most expected of the three; the craft has to be in the folding motion and the live preview or it reads as a settings form.

options.label: Shelf Composer
options.lineage: Mail's Smart Mailbox editor grown into a two-pane workbench
options.thesis: Home stays pure watching; a Composer window (⌥⌘H) holds the shelf list on the left and the selected shelf's rules and live grid on the right.
materials: rule editor over a live grid
options.viewport: A separate window: left, a source list of shelves per Home (Home, Movies, TV Shows, Courses), each with a checkbox and drag order; right, the selected shelf: name, source, rule rows, sort and limit on top, the live poster grid it produces below. Changes appear on Home behind it as you type. ⌘K is a plain list palette.
options.risk: A second window is one more place to learn; quick tweaks (hide this shelf) also need a right-click on Home itself.

regions.label: Home · Movies · TV · Courses shelf list
